headings: 7. Add Epidemics to the Player Deck

ruleStickerSlots.context: Large dashed box at the top left, numbered setup step 5. The printed note says rule sticker E will provide step 5 and to skip the step for now. It sits before 6b (the deal) and beside steps 7–9.

sections.heading: 5. Setup step 5 (missing)
mechanicsSummary: No rule is printed. Skip step 5 until rule sticker E is applied.

sections.heading: 6b. Deal Cards
mechanicsSummary: Shuffle the chosen Event cards, all Produce Supplies cards, and the City cards together.
Deal by player count: 4 cards at 2 players, 3 cards at 3 players, 2 cards at 4 players.
Hands stay face up for the whole game.
Epidemics are not in this shuffle. They are added in step 7 to the deck that remains after the deal.

sections.heading: 7. Add Epidemics to the Player Deck
mechanicsSummary: Split the remaining Player deck into 5 face-down piles, as equal as possible.
Stack the piles into the Player deck with the smaller piles on the bottom.

sections.heading: 8. Select Characters
mechanicsSummary: Each player picks a character and a color, and takes the matching pawn and Reference cards.
Each pawn starts at that character's home.
If there are fewer characters than players, the extra players use haven workers.

sections.heading: 9. Begin Play
mechanicsSummary: Randomly choose one pawn. That player is first.

sections.heading: On Your Turn
mechanicsSummary: Four steps, in order: check for exposure; take 4 actions; draw 2 Player cards; infect cities.
After the infect step, the turn passes to the player on the left.
Anyone may advise. The player whose turn it is decides.
A hand holds City cards, Produce Supplies cards, and Event cards.
City cards are spent on some actions. Produce Supplies cards move cubes from the stockpile onto havens and supply centers. Event cards may be played at any time.

diagramsAndCallouts: Board diagram labels Game End cards, Infection Rate marker, Infection Rate track, Infection deck, Infection discard, Player deck, and Player discard.
City panels in that diagram show lettered boxes (groups reading A–D and A–E). Those are board search boxes, not manual rule-sticker slots.
The board's own turn reminder repeats the four steps and, unlike the blue rules box, mentions resolving epidemics as part of the draw.
Five-pile diagram: one Epidemic shuffled into each pile, then stacked.

Sample pawn, two-sided actions reference, and a character card (home Asgard, age 28) whose pictured job mentions a Transfer Supplies free action that can move supply cubes to or from a player at any location.
